# React JS Quiz

> Free interactive quizzes and MCQs to prepare for React.js technical interviews, covering Hooks, component lifecycle, performance, testing, TypeScript, state management, and more.

ReactJsQuiz.com offers structured multiple-choice questions with explanations across every major React topic, plus a blog with in-depth interview-prep articles. Each quiz question includes the correct answer and a short explanation grounded in real React behavior.

## Quiz topics

- [React Basics](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/basic): Fundamentals of React, JSX, components, props, and state.
- [Hooks](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/hooks): useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useReducer, useContext, useImperativeHandle, useTransition, useDeferredValue, useSyncExternalStore, useId, useLayoutEffect, useInsertionEffect, useDebugValue, useOptimistic, and custom hooks.
- [Component Lifecycle](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/component-lifecycle): Mounting, updating, and unmounting phases in class and functional components.
- [Performance Optimization](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/performance-optimization): Memoization, React.memo, code splitting, lazy loading, and rendering optimizations.
- [React Patterns](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/react-patterns): Higher-order components, render props, compound components, and common design patterns.
- [React APIs](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/react-apis): React.memo, forwardRef, createContext, lazy, Suspense, and other top-level APIs.
- [React Router](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/react-router): Routing, navigation, dynamic routes, and route guards.
- [React Forms](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/react-forms): Controlled and uncontrolled inputs, validation, and submit handling.
- [Error Boundaries](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/error-boundaries): componentDidCatch, getDerivedStateFromError, fallback UI, and error-handling limits.
- [Portals](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/portals): createPortal, modal rendering, event bubbling through portals, and context behavior.
- [Suspense](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/suspense): Suspense boundaries, fallbacks, lazy components, nested loading states, and transitions.
- [React Testing](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/react-testing): React Testing Library, component tests, queries, user events, and async testing.
- [TypeScript with React](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/react-typescript): Typing props, events, children, refs, hooks, and common React types.
- [State Management Libraries](https://reactjsquiz.com/quizzes/state-management-libraries): Redux Toolkit, Zustand, TanStack Query, client vs. server state, selectors, and tradeoffs.
- [React Native Quizzes](https://reactjsquiz.com/react-native-quizzes): Quizzes for React Native — navigation, components and UI, performance, device features, state management, and debugging.

## Blog

- [5 Fundamental React Hooks Every Developer Should Know](https://reactjsquiz.com/blog/5-fundamental-react-hooks-every-developer-should-know): useState, useEffect, useContext, useRef, and useImperativeHandle explained for interview prep.
- [Understanding the Virtual DOM in React](https://reactjsquiz.com/blog/understanding-the-virtual-dom-in-react): How React's Virtual DOM diffs and reconciles updates against the real DOM.
- [State Management in React: useState, useReducer, and Context API](https://reactjsquiz.com/blog/state-management-in-react-a-guide-to-usestate-usereducer-and-context-api): When to use each state primitive and how they compare.
- [React Performance Optimization Techniques](https://reactjsquiz.com/blog/react-performance-optimization-techniques): Memoization, code splitting, and rendering optimizations for scaling React apps.
- [Understanding Prop Drilling in React and How to Avoid It](https://reactjsquiz.com/blog/understanding-prop-drilling-in-react-and-how-to-avoid-it): Patterns for replacing prop drilling with Context or composition.
- [Understanding Refs in React and When to Use Them](https://reactjsquiz.com/blog/understanding-refs-in-react-and-when-to-use-them): useRef, forwardRef, and accessing the DOM or component instances directly.
- [Integrating Third-Party Libraries in React](https://reactjsquiz.com/blog/integrating-third-party-libraries-in-react): How to wrap, adapt, and use external libraries inside React applications.
- [React Memoization Techniques: useMemo vs useCallback](https://reactjsquiz.com/blog/react-memoization-techniques-usememo-vs-usecallback): When to use useMemo vs useCallback and how each affects re-renders.
- [How to Manage Side Effects with useEffect in React](https://reactjsquiz.com/blog/how-to-manage-side-effects-with-useeffect-in-react): Data fetching, subscriptions, cleanup, and the dependency array.
- [React DevTools: A Guide for Debugging Your React Apps](https://reactjsquiz.com/blog/react-devtools-a-guide-for-debugging-your-react-apps): Inspecting components, hooks, and performance profiling in the browser.
